args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring health and error rate.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; on-call was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
